desc:
Shoot for Brainrot! 🎯

💥 Shoot, catch & collect Brainrots!
🌊 Survive the tsunami you just triggered!
💸 Place your Brainrots on your plot and make money!
💪 Farm Damage to catch stronger Brainrots!
🔥 Upgrade your Brainrots and build the ultimate collection!
🏆 Can you collect the strongest Brainrots?

🙏 Thanks for playing! 👍 Like and favorite if you enjoy the game!

Do not use exploits or cheats. Our anti-hack system will detect and ban exploiters.
